blurb: Landmark Lanes offers bowling, retro arcade games, pool, steel tip darts, live music, and a large selection of domestic and craft brews. It has three unique bars with daily drink specials and a karaoke room called The Moon Room. The venue hosts events including Magic: The Gathering tournaments and private parties.
extraNote: No reservations for bowling except for parties booked at least 1 week in advance · Bowling prices vary by day from $4.50 to $5 per game, shoe rental not included
